name: Bonvenu Bancorp, Inc.
summary: Bonvenu Bancorp, Inc. functions as the parent entity for Citizens National Bank, extending a comprehensive suite of banking services to both individual and corporate clients. Its deposit offerings encompass checking, savings, and individual retirement (IRA) accounts, alongside certificates of deposit (CDs). The institution finances a variety of needs through its diverse loan portfolio. For personal customers, this includes options for vacations, home equity, home construction, lines of credit, and a range of other consumer demands, in addition to financing for vehicles such as automobiles, boats, trailers, motorcycles, and ATVs. Businesses can access credit for construction projects, real estate ventures, industrial operations, and specialized programs like Small Business Administration (SBA) and United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) loans, alongside general mortgage products. Furthermore, Bonvenu Bancorp delivers extensive investment solutions. These cover financial, retirement, education, and estate planning, asset management, structured products, trust services, small business investment guidance, and employer benefits planning. Its broader service catalog also features merchant services, various credit card options, and convenient online and mobile banking platforms. Established in 1985, Bonvenu Bancorp, Inc. is headquartered in Bossier City, Louisiana. The company, which was previously known as Citizens National Bancshares of Bossier, Inc., officially adopted its current name, Bonvenu Bancorp, Inc., in April 2024.
